sources_note: 來源與日期逐篇列明。公司公告按原文歸因，開放範圍以可核對的資料為準。
sources_note_en: Each story lists its source and date. Company announcements are attributed and availability follows the documented scope.
thesis: AI購物入口增多，品牌可先把商品資料、審批和量度流程接好
thesis_en: As AI shopping entry points multiply, align product data, approvals and measurement
thesis_note: 由ChatGPT商家中心到香港冬日節，先核對開放條件，再為每個入口指定資料與成效負責人。
thesis_note_en: From ChatGPT Business Hub to Hong Kong WinterFest, check eligibility and assign owners for data and measurement at each entry point.

廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: OpenAI試推ChatGPT商家中心，美國合資格商戶可設品牌代理
items.summary: 商家中心進入測試階段，合資格商戶可認領品牌資料。品牌代理先向合資格的美國電商及線上服務商戶開放。
highlights: 商戶通過驗證後可更新資料及提交含售價和庫存的產品資料。
匯總數據包括品牌提及及網站點擊，達到門檻才顯示。
items.why: 品牌可以把AI搜尋中的店家資料和顧客自助問答納入同一套營運流程。
items.next_step: 先核對商戶所在地及資格，再指定產品資料更新和客服答覆的負責人。
items.detail: OpenAI公布商家可在Business Hub認領品牌，通過驗證後管理資料及提交產品清單。符合門檻的商戶可看到提及和網站點擊等匯總數據。另一項功能Business Agents先開放給合資格的美國電商及線上服務商戶。顧客可從品牌檔案選擇開始對話，由品牌代理使用企業提供的資料回答產品或服務問題。
items.title_en: OpenAI launches a ChatGPT business hub beta and agents for eligible US businesses
items.summary_en: Eligible businesses can claim their profiles in the Business Hub beta. Business Agents are initially open to eligible US ecommerce and online service businesses.
highlights_en: Verified businesses can update their profile and submit product feeds with prices and availability.
Aggregate mentions and website clicks are visible when thresholds are met.
items.why_en: Brands can manage AI discovery profiles and customer self-service as part of the same workflow.
items.next_step_en: Confirm market and business eligibility, then assign owners for feed updates and support responses.
items.detail_en: OpenAI says eligible companies can claim a profile in Business Hub. Verified businesses can update details and submit a product feed. Businesses that meet data thresholds can see aggregate mentions and site clicks. Business Agents initially serve eligible US ecommerce and online service businesses. Shoppers can start a separate chat from a profile to ask the brand agent about its offerings.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: 香港冬日節聯動三區活動與逾百項商戶優惠
items.summary: 旅發局公布冬日節在中環、尖沙咀及銅鑼灣設不同主題，並加入指定電子支付優惠。
highlights: 旅發局計劃於11月18日展開活動，至翌年1月5日。
AlipayHK、Alipay和Alipay+的優惠按指定商戶、支付條件及供應而定。
items.why: 零售及餐飲團隊可按分區活動和兌換條件設計店內導流。
items.next_step: 逐區核對活動時段和商戶名單，再安排店內標示、優惠券和兌換統計。
items.detail: 旅發局公布中環、尖沙咀和銅鑼灣各有冬日節安排，各區按個別日程開始。旅發局亦與AlipayHK、Alipay及Alipay+合作，在參與商戶提供超過100項優惠，受指定二維碼支付條件及供應限制。品牌可按商圈活動和優惠資格規劃宣傳，並用門店專屬代碼量度實際兌換。
items.title_en: Hong Kong WinterFest links three districts with over 100 merchant offers
items.summary_en: The Hong Kong Tourism Board announced distinct programmes in Central, Tsim Sha Tsui and Causeway Bay alongside selected digital payment offers.
highlights_en: The board plans to run the festival from November 18 through January 5.
AlipayHK, Alipay and Alipay+ offers depend on participating merchants, payment terms and supply.
items.why_en: Retail and dining teams can align in-store traffic campaigns with district events and redemption terms.
items.next_step_en: Check event times and merchant lists before scheduling signage, vouchers and redemption reporting.
items.detail_en: The tourism board announced WinterFest programmes in Central, Tsim Sha Tsui and Causeway Bay, with staggered district starts. It also partnered with AlipayHK, Alipay and Alipay+ on over 100 offers at participating merchants, subject to designated QR payments and supply. Brands can plan by district and eligibility and track actual redemptions with store-specific codes.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Google推Gemini Decisions API，可批次分類廣告素材
items.summary: Google的新端點可對同一份多模態素材回答多道預設問題，並回傳選項分數。
highlights: 每次請求最多處理1,000道獨立問題。
可經Google AI Studio免費試做原型。
items.why: 創意和媒體團隊可用一致問題標記素材，並把模糊結果送交人工審閱。
items.next_step: 選一批已標記的廣告素材，先比較自動分類與人工分類的差異。
items.detail: Google表示Gemini Decisions API會在一次處理內對同一份多模態輸入回答多道分類問題，並對選項給分。團隊可用固定的素材標籤試做分類，例如檢查品牌標誌是否出現或素材屬於哪個創意主題。分數是否適合做發布門檻，應先用已有人手標記的素材驗證，並為不確定個案保留人工覆核。
items.title_en: Google launches Gemini Decisions API for batch creative classification
items.summary_en: Google's new endpoint can ask multiple predefined questions about the same multimodal input and return scores for the choices.
highlights_en: A request can contain up to 1,000 independent questions.
Teams can prototype at no cost in Google AI Studio.
items.why_en: Creative and media teams can use consistent labels and route ambiguous assets to reviewers.
items.next_step_en: Start with labeled ads and compare automated classification with human labels.
items.detail_en: Google says Gemini Decisions API evaluates multiple classification questions about one multimodal input in a single pass and scores the choices. Teams can try fixed creative tags such as logo presence or campaign theme. Validate scores against human-labeled assets before setting a publishing threshold and keep manual review for ambiguous cases.

items.title: 更進新聞：Scrunch列出AI引用來源，協助擬定媒體聯絡內容
items.summary: Sitecore旗下Scrunch推出Citation Optimization，可查閱AI答案引用的第三方頁面及其優先次序。
highlights: 可檢視哪些來源提及品牌或競爭對手。
Scrunch稱功能已可使用，資料亦會供MarketingIQ參考。
items.why: 公關團隊可把AI搜尋監測連到具體刊物和評測頁，優先核實資料缺口。
items.next_step: 抽查十條重要查詢，核對主要引用頁，再把聯絡草稿交公關審閱。
items.detail: Scrunch表示新功能會按追蹤的提示詞列出第三方引用頁，並按影響及接觸機會排序。團隊可查閱頁面已收錄的品牌及競爭對手，再以已批准的品牌資料擬定聯絡內容。資料可供MarketingIQ參考，公關團隊仍應逐一核對頁面內容，並記錄對方是否更新。
items.title_en: Update: Scrunch maps AI citations and helps draft publisher outreach
items.summary_en: Sitecore's Scrunch launched Citation Optimization to identify and prioritize third-party pages cited in AI answers.
highlights_en: Teams can see which sources mention their brand or competitors.
Scrunch says the feature is available and its data informs MarketingIQ.
items.why_en: PR teams can link AI-search monitoring to specific publications and review pages and validate gaps.
items.next_step_en: Sample ten important queries, verify the main citations and have PR review outreach drafts.
items.detail_en: Scrunch says the feature finds third-party citations for tracked prompts and prioritizes pages by influence and outreach opportunity. Teams can see which brands and competitors are included and draft pitches with approved brand information. The data can inform MarketingIQ. PR teams should check cited pages individually and track whether publishers make updates.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.followup: 11月12日版報道MarketingIQ。本次新增的是Scrunch的第三方來源排序與聯絡功能。
items.followup_en: November 12 covered MarketingIQ. The new story is Scrunch's third-party citation prioritization and outreach.

items.title: 中國雙11收官，Syntun估主要平台銷售增4.8%
items.summary: 路透引述Syntun估算，中國主要電商平台雙11促銷期銷售額按年升4.8%。
highlights: 估算涵蓋10月7日至11月11日。
淘寶、天貓及京東未公布整體商品交易總額。
items.why: 品牌可用行業估算作參考，再以自家與口徑數據檢查品類、促銷期及購物入口表現。
items.next_step: 對齊今年和去年的活動日數及品類，再核對各入口的訂單及退貨。
items.detail: 路透引述Syntun對主要電商平台的雙11促銷期估算，銷售額按年升4.8%。淘寶、天貓和京東主要披露部分品類、品牌及用戶指標，未公布整體商品交易總額。平台使用了AI購物工具，報道指工具對銷售的貢獻仍未能確定。品牌可把入口、品類及活動日數分開檢視。
items.title_en: Syntun estimates 4.8% Singles' Day sales growth across major Chinese platforms
items.summary_en: Reuters cited Syntun's estimate of 4.8% year-on-year sales growth across major Chinese platforms during the Singles' Day promotion.
highlights_en: The estimate covers October 7 through November 11.
Taobao, Tmall and JD.com did not disclose overall gross merchandise value.
items.why_en: Brands can use the estimate as a reference and compare their own categories, campaign windows and shopping entry points on a consistent basis.
items.next_step_en: Match campaign duration and categories year-on-year, then compare orders and returns by entry point.
items.detail_en: Reuters cited Syntun's estimate of 4.8% sales growth across major ecommerce platforms during Singles' Day. Taobao, Tmall and JD.com highlighted selected category, brand and user figures without releasing overall gross merchandise value. Platforms used AI shopping tools, whose sales contribution Reuters said remained unclear. Teams can review entry points, categories and campaign duration separately.

items.title: 更進新聞：Adobe展示跨鏡頭剪輯原型，兩項影像工具可試
items.summary: Adobe MAX展示10項研發原型，包括跨鏡頭套用場景修改的Scene Sweep。
highlights: Deep Brush和Hands On可在Adobe Labs Playground試用。
Scene Sweep屬研發展示，正式工具的開放安排仍待公布。
items.why: 影像團隊可按已開放的原型安排試驗，並保留跨鏡頭一致性檢查。
items.next_step: 選一段包含不同鏡頭的樣片，記錄場景修改中最耗時的連戲工作。
items.detail: Adobe公布的10項Sneaks聚焦創意工作流程的研發，其中Scene Sweep展示同一場景修改如何延續至其他鏡頭。Adobe另列出Deep Brush和Hands On可在Labs Playground試用。團隊可用這份名單安排短期試驗，並把跨鏡頭修改當作日後評估項目，記錄連戲和審稿要求。
items.title_en: Update: Adobe previews edits across video cuts and offers two image experiments
items.summary_en: Adobe MAX showed 10 R&D prototypes, including Scene Sweep, which carries a scene edit across cuts.
highlights_en: Deep Brush and Hands On can be tried in Adobe Labs Playground.
Scene Sweep is an R&D demonstration, with product availability still to be announced.
items.why_en: Creative teams can plan around experiments they can access and keep continuity checks in their process.
items.next_step_en: Take a short sequence with different shots and note which continuity fixes consume the most time.
items.detail_en: Adobe's 10 Sneaks preview creative R&D. Scene Sweep demonstrates how the same scene edit could carry across shots. Adobe lists Deep Brush and Hands On among the experiments available in Labs Playground. Teams can use the list to plan near-term trials and track continuity and approval needs for future cross-shot editing.
items.followup: 11月12日版報道Creative Agent擴展。這批Sneaks早於該期公布，新增報道聚焦10項研發展示及指定Labs試用名單。
items.followup_en: The November 12 edition covered Creative Agent expansion. Adobe announced these Sneaks before that edition. This update covers 10 R&D demos and named Labs experiments.

items.title: Ads Uploader為Meta廣告代理加入可配置審批
items.summary: 第三方工具Ads Uploader推出Agent Inbox。設為Approval的操作，須由人員批准才會送往Meta。
highlights: 發布及修改權限可按廣告帳戶分開設定。
審批畫面顯示原值、新值和理由，支援部分批准及操作紀錄。
items.why: 代理商可為新廣告及在投素材設不同權限，以配合各客戶的審批制度。
items.next_step: 挑一個測試帳戶，分別核對發布和修改的權限，並驗證部分批准的紀錄。
items.detail: Ads Uploader表示Agent Inbox接收透過其MCP提出的Meta廣告發布及修改建議。團隊可按廣告帳戶分開設置發布與修改權限，使用Approval時才會暫停操作並等待人手批准。審批人員可看原值、新值和理由，選擇批准部分修改，系統會記錄操作。
items.title_en: Ads Uploader adds configurable review for Meta ad agents
items.summary_en: Third-party tool Ads Uploader introduced Agent Inbox. Actions set to Approval require a reviewer before they reach Meta.
highlights_en: Launch and edit permissions can be set independently per ad account.
Reviewers see old and proposed values and reasons, can approve selected changes and have an action log.
items.why_en: Agencies can set different permissions for new ads and live creative to fit each client's review policy.
items.next_step_en: In a test account, check launch and edit permissions separately and verify the log after partial approval.
items.detail_en: Ads Uploader says Agent Inbox receives Meta ad launch and edit proposals made through its MCP. Teams set launch and edit permissions independently by ad account. Approval mode pauses actions for human review. Reviewers see current values, proposals and reasons, can approve selected changes, and have a record of actions.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: BlueMedia公布面向中國出海品牌的ChatGPT Ads服務
items.summary: BlueMedia稱已為首批品牌客戶投放ChatGPT Ads，服務涵蓋策略、到達頁審查和投放監測。
highlights: 公司列出電商、旅遊和AI應用的行業方案。
公告未列出首批客戶投放市場和商業條款。
items.why: 出海團隊可先核對目標市場資格和量度方法，再評估代投服務。
items.next_step: 索取適用市場、帳戶及追蹤資料的管理安排，確認後才設定試投預算。
items.detail: BlueMedia公布面向中國出海品牌的ChatGPT Ads服務，並稱已為首批品牌客戶投放。公司描述的服務包括受眾意圖分析、到達頁審查、執行和監測，另列出電商、旅遊及AI應用的行業方案。公告未列明首批投放市場或條款，品牌應按目標市場逐一確認資格與數據取得方式。
items.title_en: BlueMedia announces ChatGPT Ads services for Chinese brands going abroad
items.summary_en: BlueMedia says it has run ChatGPT Ads for its first group of brand clients. Its service spans strategy, landing page review and monitoring.
highlights_en: The company lists services for ecommerce, travel and AI applications.
The release did not specify the initial clients' ad markets or commercial terms.
items.why_en: Cross-border teams can check market eligibility and measurement before assessing managed services.
items.next_step_en: Ask about supported markets, account control and tracking access before setting a test budget.
items.detail_en: BlueMedia announced ChatGPT Ads services for Chinese brands going abroad and said it had run campaigns for an initial group of clients. Its stated services cover intent analysis, landing page review, execution and monitoring, with sector offerings for ecommerce, travel and AI apps. The release did not name initial ad markets or terms. Check eligibility and data access for each target market.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: ZEPIC公布Neura，把廣告入口接到購物對話
items.summary: ZEPIC稱Neura可讓部分廣告及商家檔案把顧客帶到WhatsApp，也支援品牌網站聊天。
highlights: 公告列出Shopify、Magento和客戶資料平台等接入例子。
公司描述了附近門店庫存查詢及轉交真人客服。
items.why: 零售團隊可在同一條顧客旅程評估廣告入口、商品查詢和客服交接。
items.next_step: 先選一個廣告入口，確認可接入的商品資料、庫存更新頻率及客服轉接條件。
items.detail: ZEPIC公布對話式購物工具Neura，入口包括可導向WhatsApp的廣告或商家檔案，以及品牌網站聊天。公司展示接入電商與客戶資料系統後的使用情境，包括查詢附近門店存貨及轉交真人客服。品牌規劃試點時應先確認各入口、商店系統及客服隊列的接入條件。
items.title_en: ZEPIC introduces Neura to connect ad entry points with shopping chats
items.summary_en: ZEPIC says selected ads and business profiles can send customers to WhatsApp, and Neura also supports chat on brand sites.
highlights_en: The announcement names Shopify, Magento and customer data systems as integration examples.
ZEPIC describes nearby store stock checks and handoff to human support.
items.why_en: Retail teams can assess ad entry, product questions and service handoffs as one customer journey.
items.next_step_en: Choose one ad entry point and confirm product data, inventory refresh rates and support handoff rules.
items.detail_en: ZEPIC announced Neura, a conversational shopping product with entry points including ads or profiles that lead to WhatsApp and chat on a brand website. Its announced commerce and customer data integrations support scenarios such as checking nearby store stock and handing off to a person. Confirm each channel, store system and support queue before a pilot.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: 日本精工以音樂及機械動作重塑工業品牌形象
items.summary: 日本精工NSK發布由水曜日的康帕內拉主唱詩羽出演的電視廣告，傳達解決方案夥伴定位。
highlights: 企業廣告主題為MOTION is SOLUTION。
原創樂曲與使用NSK產品的裝置動作同步。
items.why: 工業品牌可用看得見的產品動作，讓抽象定位在創意中有具體依據。
items.next_step: 選一個能示範的核心技術，先用短片把它和品牌想解決的問題連起來。
items.detail: NSK把MOTION is SOLUTION用於新一輪企業廣告，傳達從軸承製造商走向為工業及社會解決問題的夥伴。新電視廣告由詩羽出演，原創歌曲與裝有NSK產品的裝置動作配合。工業品牌可參考這種安排，讓受眾先從具體產品動作理解新的企業定位。樂曲以滾動、碰撞及反彈等動作為創作題材。
items.title_en: Japan's NSK uses music and machinery to refresh its industrial brand
items.summary_en: NSK unveiled a TV ad starring Utaha of Wednesday Campanella to communicate its positioning as a solutions partner.
highlights_en: The corporate campaign uses the theme MOTION is SOLUTION.
The original song is synchronized with the movements of devices using NSK products.
items.why_en: Industrial brands can use visible product movements to make abstract positioning tangible.
items.next_step_en: Choose one demonstrable technology and connect it to the problem your brand wants to solve in a short clip.
items.detail_en: NSK is using MOTION is SOLUTION in corporate advertising to communicate its evolution from bearing maker to a partner solving industrial and social problems. The TV commercial stars Utaha and pairs an original song with the movements of equipment using NSK products. Industrial brands can apply the idea by making visible product behavior the starting point for new positioning. The composition draws on motions such as rolling, collision and rebound.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
